mechanics.claim: Warwick heals for a percentage of the post-mitigation damage dealt by the bite.
mechanics.quote: healing himself for a percentage of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and most modifiers.}} dealt

mechanics.claim: The ability applies on-hit effects and life steal, and triggers on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects

mechanics.claim: The health-ratio damage component is capped against monsters at a flat value instead.
mechanics.quote: The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped against {{tip|monster|monsters}}.

mechanics.claim: The healing is calculated only from the bite's own damage, not from on-hit or other added effects.
mechanics.quote: The healing is calculated only from ''Jaws of the Beast's'' damage, while additional effects, such as on-hits, are not.

mechanics.claim: If the target dies before Warwick reaches them on a tapped cast, the ability's cooldown (not mana cost) is refunded.
mechanics.quote: If the target dies prior to '''Warwick''' reaching them, ''Jaws of the Beast'' refunds its cooldown when tapped.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts only after the bite effect resolves, not on cast.
